name: Modbus TCP
description: Read and write Modbus TCP registers on PLCs, gateways and remote IO couplers, connecting to the host and port you enter (502 by default). Devices and address ranges are configured inside the workbench, with polling and inline writes that only send on Enter.
releaseNotes: 0.2.1 is a version update of this listing. Creating a connection asks only for a workspace name: devices are configured and connected inside the workbench, and a workbench opened with no connection still works. A new range reads ten addresses, editing its definition reads again on the spot, and a value is written only by pressing Enter in the cell - Esc or leaving the field cancels. The package now ships the MIT LICENSE.
